objective: Find a pre-registered, parameter-free per-bar detector that flags silently mis-phased downbeats with recall >= 0.90 and false-alarm rate <= 0.05.
current_unknown: Whether the downbeat-phase errors found in GRID-METER-001 can be detected per bar so craft automation can fail closed.
hypothesis: D1 (in-bar activation contrast), D2 (cross-decoder disagreement) or D3 (D1 or D2) meets both criteria for at least one primary decoder.
competing_hypotheses: No cheap signal separates mis-phased from correct downbeats without unacceptable false alarms.

stages.output: Detectors and criteria pre-registered in commit 671d9eb before any detector ran.
GRID-METER-001 error set reused as ground-truth failure population.
32/32 FIXTURE_ACCEPTED; 24/24 GRID-METER-001 fixtures bit-identical after generator change.
tools/grid-meter/detect.py, run_detect.py, score_detect.py; constant-meter variant fixtures.
10/10 self-tests pass, incl. detector quiet-on-correct and flags-phase-shift.
False-alarm traps: syncopated chord anticipation and half-time drum switch (meter unchanged). D2 produced 0 false alarms on both; D1 produced 5 each.
32 fixtures, 2 primary decoders, 3 detectors in 358 s.
D3 passes for madmom DBN on point estimates (recall 0.920, FA 0.038); D2 is precise (0/524 FA) but recall 0.869; detectors fail for Beat This!+DBN where reference shares its network.
Next: GRID-METER-003 real-track validation (needs human-confirmed bar annotations).

attacks.relevance: Syncopation (early chord arrival) can masquerade as a downbeat shift (Pass 05 F3).
attacks.detail: madmom D3 false alarms 5/132 on sync_anticip, all from D1; D2 0/132.

attacks.relevance: Half-time drum switch changes felt pulse without meter change (Pass 05 F4).
attacks.detail: madmom D3 false alarms 5/132 on halftime_switch, all from D1; D2 0/132.

regression_check.detail: 24/24 fixtures bit-identical after adding variant support.

limitations: Synthetic fixtures only; real-track recall and false-alarm rate unknown.
Confidence intervals straddle both thresholds; pass is on point estimates only.
D3 needs two networks per track; mobile cost unknown.
D1 false alarms are structured (track end; crash bars at 174 BPM).

next_recommended_experiment.reason: Synthetic pass is necessary but not sufficient; odd-bar prevalence and real-track detector performance are the deciding unknowns.

human_interventions: GRID-METER-003 requires human-confirmed bar-level annotations of real tracks (Daniel's library, by ear) or use of a public downbeat-annotated dataset.
